Subject: Vendor onboarding: staggered MSA walk-through & backup slots

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference rollout. To keep the legal and technical reviews focused, we recommend splitting the onboarding into two short sessions: 1) MSA redline walk-through with Legal (30–45m) and 2) technical onboarding / SSO & network checklist with our platform engineer (45–60m).

Can you share a couple of windows (your local time) next week that work for Legal + Procurement? We have the following high-level constraints:
- Preferred: two sessions on the same day (morning legal, afternoon tech) to reduce cross-team context switching.
- Backups: please suggest one alternate day in case procurement approvals run late.
- Timezones: Novus team is PT; we can accommodate up to 4pm PT.

Attached: MSA_redline_v3.pdf (latest internal pass) and onboarding-checklist.xlsx.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue 2027-08-10 — Legal 9:00–9:45 / Tech 13:00–14:00
- Option B: Wed 2027-08-11 — Legal 10:00–10:45 / Tech 15:00–16:00

If you prefer, we can reserve a 30-minute canary slot the day before (short walk-through) so the deep-dive runs smoother. Once you confirm people and preferred slots I’ll send calendar invites and a DocuSign pre-fill link for the updated MSA.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
